basis: Cerence’s February 4 earnings release forecast consolidated GAAP revenue of $58 million to $62 million for fiscal Q2, the quarter ending March 31, 2026. The $62 million high end implied a 20.52% decline from the prior-year quarter’s $78,010,000 and was below the $74,109,500 cutoff. Cerence subsequently reported $64,192,000, above guidance but still below the cutoff.

coverage.detail: November 19, 2025, preceding earnings cycle. Cerence guided to $110 million–$120 million for fiscal Q1 ending December 31, 2025, and $300 million–$320 million for all of FY2026. Neither range established a ceiling for the March quarter.

The issuer calendar identifies the November 19 earnings call, December 8 Raymond James conference and January 13 Needham conference. A check of the public management transcripts found no March-quarter consolidated revenue range. At Needham, the CFO reiterated the fiscal Q1 and full-year ranges.
The December 29 Form 8-K disclosed a repurchase of $30 million principal amount of convertible notes. It gave no quarterly sales outlook.
February 4, Exhibit 99.2. Slide 17 explicitly labels the fiscal Q2 range as GAAP revenue and gives 58,000 low and 62,000 high in thousands of dollars. The annual range appears in separate columns.

Cerence’s release archive timestamps the February 4 earnings announcement at 4:05 p.m. EST. Between that release and the May 7 actuals, the archive lists product, conference and litigation announcements and an April 27 notice scheduling the results. No preliminary Q2 revenue or revised Q2 range appeared.
The February 18 Form 8-K reported voting results from the February 12 annual meeting. It contained no revenue update.
The March 16 announcement described the CFO’s March 23 Roth conference participation as one-on-one investor meetings. It supplied no public revenue estimate.

May 7 actuals. The condensed consolidated statements of operations report total revenues of $64,192,000 and $78,010,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, respectively. Both totals include license, connected services and professional services revenue.
EDGAR records acceptance of the February 4 Form 8-K at 16:40:16 that day and identifies the earnings release and presentation as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2.

publication_date_evidence: Cerence’s IR archive records public release on February 4, 2026 at 4:05 p.m. EST. The earnings release carries the same date, and EDGAR accepted the exhibits later that afternoon.
